images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5 cinematic poster on a red Martian archaeological dig exposing a colossal buried civilization. An attractive adult Korean Shorthair cheese-tabby cat; natural balanced sturdy build; bright warm orange short coat with realistic darker tabby stripes; clean white fur on muzzle and chin continuing naturally through neck, chest and belly; all four paws clean white from toes upward; a distinctive congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around the mouth resembling a curry stain, explicitly not food or dirt; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The cat is a mystical portal guardian in an original weathered cloak, showing furious internet-meme glare and body stretched toward camera with correct feline proportions. One paw reaches toward a glass bottle containing a tiny paper boat riding violent waves while the outside air is clear; a miniature skyship turns through a safe theatrical lightning storm behind it. A luminous geometric portal opens to a flooded historical summer alley, and a colossal projected eye towers in the background. Camera distance three meters, low forward viewpoint, 18mm lens, layered depth of field with cat sharp and ruins slightly atmospheric, red sunset, electric violet portal light, realistic glass refraction, dust, paw contact, and shadows. Forced perspective and projection are visibly safe staged effects. Correct feline anatomy, no duplicate cats, no extra limbs, no human features, no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, or readable title.
